name: resistance band front plank with kicked leg
description: A plank hold while one leg kicks back against a band, working the glutes and core together.
instructions: Place a band around your feet or ankles and get into a forearm or high plank.
Brace your core so your body forms a straight line.
Kick one leg back and up against the band without shifting your hips.
Alternate legs, keeping your hips level throughout.
